<h1 id="upgrade-order-magic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Upgrade Order - Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction-disclaimer"><ins><nowiki>Introduction &amp; Disclaimer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 26th October 2026</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The order is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>subject to change at any time</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Please note the following assumptions:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The order assume a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>starting point of T70 gear</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643151011199975434.png?v=1" alt="subjgarb" title="subjgarb" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Priorities may be different</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if you are doing niche content</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ &quot;ROI&quot; (meaning return-on-investment) typically means </nowiki><strong><nowiki>quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not recommend selling an item to buy another</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, unless it is a direct upgrade</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Unlisted items</nowiki></strong><nowiki> are not worth buying</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Feel free to ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> for a tailored list to the content that you do!</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>For further information on each upgrade, check </nowiki><span><nowiki>#armour-and-weapons</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perk-information</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#permanent-unlocks</nowiki></span><nowiki>, or </nowiki><span><nowiki>#eof-specs</nowiki></span></em></p>
<nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• P6U4 AS4E2 for 2H weapons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1" alt="ultimatums4" title="ultimatums4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1" alt="as4" title="as4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1" alt="er2" title="er2" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 88,310,671</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AS4 is a very strong perk in its own right. If you fail going for AS4E2, feel free to use AS4 in its place for the time being.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon getting Aftershock you'll now need it on all of your weapons for that style</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shard of Genesis Essence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1" alt="shardofgenesisessence" title="shardofgenesisessence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 586,493,097</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /></p>
